description: Hi! We're an enthusiastic student whos very passionate about cool space and science stuff!!!! Our goal here is building an innovative solution for this challenge and want to make a real impact :)
summary: Aetherion, an interactive space-exploration game where players step into the boots of an astronaut tasked by their Captain with researching and observing the state of our solar system. Before liftoff, players must act as mission engineers—choosing which scientific instruments, supplies, and spacecraft upgrades to bring aboard while balancing strict limits on budget, mass, power, and cargo space. Packing useless gear or heavy equipment directly impacts survival later on. Once in orbit, players pilot their ship through hazardous space obstacles—including asteroid fields, black holes, and alien encounters—managing limited resources in real time to complete their research objectives and make it home safely. This teaches the player that every choice made will have a huge impact on the future.
details:
Aetherion's Project Details

Aetherion, is an educational exploration desktop game designed to teach players about small decisions made will have a huge impact on the future. This game also turns real NASA information into a fun interactive game. Players play as an astronaut given a mission a task by their captain to research and observe a certain planet. The game uses a series of mini games to allow the player to use critical thinking and problem solving both fun and accessible. The benefit of this game is also that players can learn more about the planets in the solar system.

How does our solution work?

In this game, the player steps into the foot of an astronaut that is given a mission by their captain to gather data of a certain planet due to the lack of data in the system. Before the astronaut sets out on his mission, he has to pick out a limited number of items, but the kick is that some of the items are not relevant to bring for the journey. On the journey, the astronaut will have to go through an obstacle of asteroids, aliens and a blackhole. With that, the player has to make the correct decisions whether to avoid, shield and attack the obstacles. When arrived at the planet tasked for them, they are required to finish two tasks and answer it correctly.

What tools and coding language did we use to develop your project?

We used Claude AI to help enhance some of our ideas, videos and coding. For coding language, we used GDScript and run our game in Godot.

How is our project creative?

Our game shows how difficult problem solving and critical thinking can be fun and interactive for students to play. It also adds on real information from NASA's public website. Students can learn more about planets in our solar system.
projectRefs: Essential Items To Pack For A Space Mission
